title: The Latest Crier for Sep 10, 2026
items:
Student Senate Elections

Voting is NOW OPEN to elect members to your 2026-27 Student Senate! 
Voting has been simplified this year and is now through the following Microsoft form ! 

Once you are there, preview each of the candidate's profile before voting. Select the names of ALL of the applicants you APPROVE to serve as the student voice for the 2026-27 year! (This means you can select one or all candidates, whoever you approve) 

You have from now (9/7) to Friday (9/11) at 5 p.m. to place your vote !
